tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Scientific and Technological Progress- Benefits vs Problems
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: In the past, progress in science and technology was generally slow. However, in recent decades, the pace of scientific and technological progress has increased dramatically, with new discoveries and inventions being developed almost every day. Some people think that this rapid progress in science and technology is beneficial for society overall and should be encouraged. Others believe this progress is happening too quickly and could create serious problems. Which view do you agree with, and why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: The faster discoveries are made, the better. Thanks to advances in medicine, for example, our lives are so much better than those of our great-great-grandparents. Back then, life expectancy was much shorter because of a lack of medicines that today are inexpensive and widely available. Anyone with a serious medical condition hopes for rapid scientific progress.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: The fact that most people don't have a say in how these new inventions are implemented concerns me. Just think about the loss of jobs due to the automation of many kinds of work; this has become widespread during this time of rapid technological change. People who lose their jobs will probably not believe this type of progress is beneficial.
